title: Mandatory SAFE_CURSOR_REST after host mouse input; widen edge band
observation: Operator: agents keep parking the cursor on the Sims 4 viewport/screen edge so the camera pans while developing.
Existing CAMERA_SAFE_TRAVERSE / SAFE_CURSOR_REST existed but edge_band_px=12 was too thin and diy_skill_force left the cursor at cheat-console (400,20).
CUA / host clicks on bottom HUD also leave the cursor in the pan band.
decision: Widen default edge_band_px to 48; keep SAFE_CURSOR_REST as the single terminal park owner in camera_traverse + win32_input.

P124: scripts.win32_input.send_click/send_wheel/right_drag default safe_rest_after=True → park_safe_cursor_rest(); diy_skill_force console refocus and household/level execute must end parked interior.
Agents must not invent a second edge policy; call python -m scripts.camera_traverse rest or park_safe_cursor_rest. Hotkey-first still preferred over edge HUD clicks.
DISPATCHED skill ledger and panel PASS rules unchanged.
